Sun & Moon series · SUM

Sun & Moon

Released February 3, 2017 · 173 cards

Expanded

Sun & Moon is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sun & Moon series, released in English on February 3, 2017. Its main set has 149 cards, plus 24 secret rares numbered beyond the set (173 in total). It includes 130 Pokémon, 30 Trainer and 13 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

57 illustrators worked on Sun & Moon. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (28), Toyste Beach (9), Megumi Mizutani (7), Ryo Ueda (7), Kagemaru Himeno (5), Ken Sugimori (5), Kouki Saitou (5), match (5).
